lines.1: 「You really made me work for it. Now wake up, dammit.」
lines.2: She is still half asleep, so for now I can do whatever I want with her.
lines.5: It takes all that just to get her awake.
lines.7: 「See you downstairs in twenty minutes. Fall back asleep and I'm leaving without you.」
lines.9: After waking Crab, I head home for breakfast.
